description: Capability for the main window. Pocket Sheets is local-only: no network and no Tauri filesystem access. Storage is the webview's own IndexedDB/localStorage, import uses the native Open dialog (dialog:default) plus the read_text_file/read_bytes_file commands, and export uses the native Save As dialog (dialog:default) plus the save_text_file/save_bytes_file commands — all plain web APIs plus the native file paths, so no other permissions are needed.
